evidence: Static baseline: solution/solve.sh:4-6,37-38 only checks server.js exists, refuses to reset a database another process holds open (lines 8-35), removes /app/app.db* and runs `cp -a "$source_app/." /app/`. It runs no npm install, no vite build, no curl/wget/git fetch, so the app is never regenerated or fetched at solve time. The served front end is the prebuilt, unminified bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js (1,914,440 bytes, sha256 0ef59198...) plus index.css and public/index.html:1-3, which references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css. Committed: all 43 frozen files are git-tracked under projects/colderwater-playground-devtools, `diff -rq` of the frozen snapshot against that folder is empty, and `git diff HEAD` for that folder is empty (last commit fe8ee7a0). No CRLF in solve.sh or server.js. Pinned values: package.json:13-26 uses exact versions only; package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 3) root block equals package.json, and all 178 resolved entries point at registry.npmjs.org with integrity hashes. The bundle embeds react 19.1.1 and acorn 8.15.0, matching the pins. Runtime dependencies express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 are pinned identically in environment/Dockerfile:9-11 and tests/Dockerfile:20-21. No boot-time fetch: server.js has no outbound request; the only URLs in the bundle are XML namespaces and documentation strings in library code; server.js:16 sets a CSP of default-src 'self'. Seeding: environment/assets/seed_data.json has "snippets": [] and server.js:142-170 only creates tables, so every run starts from the same empty library. Random and wall-clock values: crypto.randomUUID in src/runtime.ts:27,317-318,335,384 and src/app.tsx:45 produces CSP nonces, guard names, run tokens and React keys; the restore operationId is also client-generated (app.tsx:82). None is displayed or graded. `new Date().toISOString()` at server.js:71,84,111 fills updated_at/created_at, which the UI sources never reference; it only orders the library list (server.js:65, with id DESC as tie-break), and history is ordered by revision (server.js:93). Grep of every judge.toml, app_context.md, instruction.md and the instruction notes found no criterion on a date, timestamp, relative time or library order, so there is no graded fixed-clock rule for wall-clock values to disturb. Source/bundle agreement: all 58 style.css class selectors are in index.css (both 9,021 bytes); most non-trivial source lines of custom-editor.js, runtime.ts and app.tsx appear verbatim in the bundle after quote/whitespace normalisation, and the sampled non-matching lines are transpilation differences (removed `export`, stripped type annotations, reflowed statements). Bundle mtime (13:10:49) is later than the newest source mtime (13:05:28). Raw evidence index: all 15 artifact hashes recomputed and match; it is scripted golden evidence only. Not measured by this review: byte-for-byte reproducibility of the bundle from src (no rebuild was run; the row does not require one because the shipped bundle is what solve.sh installs), and any Oracle, configured judge or portal run. Broken-app probe: a reference that rebuilt or fetched at solve time would show a network or build command in solve.sh; none exists. Conforming-alternative probe: a prebuilt committed bundle with random nonces is conforming, because no pinned or graded value depends on them.
